title: Automatic Queue
desc: Automatically put tracks into the queue. **Always on.** These tracks will always be located after the ones you've added manually.

title: Automatic Queue
desc: Automatically put tracks into the queue when this interface is opened. Also allows for controlling shuffle, repeat, search, sorting and playlist selection.

title: Blur
author: A theme by [@tokono.ma](https://bsky.app/profile/tokono.ma)
desc: A combination of the classic Diffuse browser and the Apple Music iOS playback screen.

title: Blur / Artwork Controller
desc: Audio playback controller with an artwork display. Play audio from the queue, add tracks to your favourites, control the queue and volume.

title: Blur / Browser
desc: Collection browser and search with favourite toggling, date grouping, and virtual scrolling.

title: Blur Classic
author: A theme by [@tokono.ma](https://bsky.app/profile/tokono.ma)
desc: A recreation of the Diffuse v3 theme with the browser of the new Blur theme.

title: Cache Tracks
desc: Store tracks locally for offline usage automatically after they've been playing for a little while.

title: Command Menu
desc: A command palette for various actions.

title: Connect
desc: A listing of some of the options available to use as an audio source, or as a user-data storage method.

title: Connect / Atmosphere
desc: Use your AT Protocol identity for user-data storage.

title: Connect / Dropbox
desc: Add Dropbox as an audio source.

title: Connect / HTTPS
desc: Add HTTPS URLs as audio sources.

title: Connect / HTTPS + JSON
desc: Add an HTTPS server with JSON directory listing support as an audio source.

title: Connect / Icecast
desc: Add an Icecast stream as an audio source.

title: Connect / Local
desc: Add local directories or files as audio sources.

title: Connect / OpenSubsonic
desc: Add an OpenSubsonic server as an audio source.

title: Connect / S3
desc: Connect to an S3-compatible storage for audio input or user-data storage.

title: Connect / WebDAV
desc: Add a WebDAV server as an audio source.

title: Default Artwork Bundle
desc: The default setup for track artwork retrieval. Adds support for: embedded audio metadata, Last.fm, and MusicBrainz.

title: Default Input Bundle
desc: The default setup for audio input sources. Adds support for: Dropbox, HTTPS, Icecast, the local filesystem, OpenSubsonic, S3-compatible storage, and WebDAV.

title: Default Metadata Bundle
desc: The default setup for track metadata lookups. Reads tags and audio stats from audio files.

title: Default Output Bundle
desc: The default setup for user-data storage output. Adds support for: AT Protocol and S3-compatible storage. For both of these a custom local-first syncing algorithm is used.

title: Export & Import
desc: Export all data as a JSON snapshot, or restore from a previously exported file.

title: iPod
author: A theme by [@tokono.ma](https://bsky.app/profile/tokono.ma)
desc: A recreation of the click-wheel iPod UI. Spin the wheel to scroll, tap the ring for menu / prev / next / play, and press the centre button to select. Alternatively, use your keyboard arrow keys.

title: Playlists
desc: Manage your playlists.

title: Preload Tracks
desc: Automatically preload the next track in the queue.

title: Process Tracks
desc: Process all your audio inputs into tracks automatically when opening any interface. Only happens once every 10 minutes, if the processing was completed.

title: Process Tracks
desc: Process all your audio sources into tracks. Shows a progress bar when processing is occuring.

title: Queue
desc: Manage your playback queue. Reorder upcoming tracks, clear the queue, and view playback history.

title: Scrobble
desc: Enable scrobbling, keep track of what you're listening to. Adds support for these scrobblers: Last.fm, ListenBrainz, Rocksky

title: Scrobble / Last.fm
desc: Connect to Last.fm to setup the Last.fm scrobbler.

title: Scrobble / ListenBrainz
desc: Connect to ListenBrainz to setup the ListenBrainz scrobbler.

title: Scrobble / Rocksky
desc: Connect to Rocksky to setup the Rocksky scrobbler.

title: Setup
desc: An interactive getting-started guide. Shows contextual next steps based on your current progress.

title: Sources
desc: An overview of all audio inputs. Disable a source to hide its tracks without removing them.

title: Split View
desc: Arrange multiple facets side-by-side in a resizable split-panel layout.

title: V3.x Import
desc: Import data from Diffuse v3.

title: Winamp
author: A theme by [@tokono.ma](https://bsky.app/profile/tokono.ma) and [@captbaritone](https://github.com/captbaritone)
desc: Windows 98 inspired theme with a classic Winamp skin for the audio player. The Winamp playlist is a combination of the queue's history, the track that's currently playing and the future queue items.

title: Winamp / Browser
desc: Collection browser and search.
